title: R1-specific source audit before exact-channel applicability survey

governance.novelty_rule: NOT_LOCATED_IN_THIS_SEARCH is never a novelty claim.

source.title: A survey of the algorithmic aspects of modular decomposition

verdict_matrix.exact_hypothesis: Applies to arbitrary finite graphs; a module is a vertex set whose vertices have identical neighborhoods outside the set.
verdict_matrix.imported_fact: The modular decomposition tree can be computed in linear time by known algorithms.
verdict_matrix.R1_effect: Module/quotient metadata may be computed as source-backed preprocessing or clustering information.

source.title: The structure and the number of P7-free bipartite graphs

verdict_matrix.exact_hypothesis: The input graph is bipartite and P7-free.
verdict_matrix.imported_fact: Every P7-free bipartite graph is totally chain-decomposable using chain decomposition and bipartite complementation.
verdict_matrix.R1_effect: If an authoritative residual or an independently justified derived object is itself bipartite and P7-free, chain decomposition is known structure and must be checked before inventing a new decomposition descriptor.
verdict_matrix.critical_mismatch: The channel graph X of an exact-channel representation is formed by retaining crossing edges and deleting same-side edges; X is not automatically an induced subgraph of G and therefore is not automatically P7-free. The chain-decomposition theorem cannot be imported onto arbitrary X without a separate P7-free proof.

verdict_matrix.topic: Efficient decomposition / mim-width consequence for P7-free bipartite graphs

source.title: Sparse Induced Subgraphs in P7-Free Graphs of Bounded Clique Number

verdict_matrix.imported_fact: The paper records that the Lozin-Zamaraev structure implies bounded mim-width for P7-free bipartite graphs and that the corresponding decomposition can be found efficiently.
verdict_matrix.R1_effect: Known decomposition infrastructure exists for the bipartite P7-free special case; R1 must not present such decomposition as new.
verdict_matrix.limitation: Known bounded-mim-width algorithms do not automatically solve the extension/CMSO2-type subproblems needed in the 2025 framework, and this is not a general C11 list-coloring terminal.

verdict_matrix.topic: Minimal separator covering in P7-free graphs

source.title: Covering Minimal Separators and Potential Maximal Cliques in Pt-Free Graphs

exact_results: For every minimal separator S in a P7-free graph, there is S' of size at most 22 with S subseteq N[S'].
For every potential maximal clique Omega in a P7-free graph, there is Omega' of size at most 68 with Omega subseteq N[Omega'].
verdict_matrix.R1_effect: Record separator-cover metadata when relevant; use as a source-backed structural feature in R3 clustering.
verdict_matrix.firewall: This bounds a neighborhood cover, not the separator size or connectivity. It does not justify bounded separators.

verdict_matrix.topic: Modular structure inside P7-free separator proofs

source.title: Covering Minimal Separators and Potential Maximal Cliques in Pt-Free Graphs

verdict_matrix.imported_fact: The P7-free separator proof explicitly uses maximal strong modules, quotient graphs, the Neighborhood Decomposition Lemma, and quasi-order structure.
verdict_matrix.R1_effect: Module quotient / neighborhood-order signatures are literature-backed features worth recording in FAIL clustering before defining a new descriptor.
verdict_matrix.does_not_imply: No exact-channel iff characterization follows from this source.

source.title: Sparse Induced Subgraphs in P7-Free Graphs of Bounded Clique Number

verdict_matrix.exact_hypothesis: Fixed d, fixed clique-number bound k, and fixed CMSO2 formula psi; target is a maximum-weight induced subgraph of treewidth at most d satisfying psi.
verdict_matrix.imported_fact: Polynomial solvability is proved on P7-free graphs of clique number at most k; the proof includes polynomial families of approximate separator/container objects and a P7-free bipartite completion analysis.
verdict_matrix.R1_effect: Potential source of future bounded-treewidth/container terminals and R3 structural features.
verdict_matrix.why_not_R1_replacement: 4-coloring the entire residual does not provide a fixed global treewidth bound d. K5 rejection can bound clique number by 4 but does not bound treewidth.

verdict_matrix.topic: Restricted P7 decomposition via clique cutsets

source.title: The class of (P7,C4,C5)-free graphs: decomposition, algorithms, and chi-boundedness

verdict_matrix.imported_fact: There is a structural characterization/decomposition for (P7,C4,C5)-free graphs without clique cutsets and polynomial coloring algorithms for that restricted class.
verdict_matrix.mismatch: Authoritative C11 residuals in this project may contain C4 and literal octahedral structures, so the extra C4/C5 exclusions are not generally available.
verdict_matrix.R1_effect: Use only on residuals that independently satisfy the extra forbidden-subgraph hypotheses.

sources.title: Even-hole-free graphs Part I: Decomposition theorem
The (theta,wheel)-free graphs Part II: structure theorem

verdict_matrix.structural_comparison: A standard 2-join has two sides with prescribed attachment sets and crossing edges restricted to complete A1-A2 and complete B1-B2 interfaces (with class-specific side conditions). Pure exact-channel permits an arbitrary bipartite channel graph X between canonical port sets plus a unique hub path.
verdict_matrix.conclusion: Known 2-join machinery is structurally adjacent but does not subsume the project's exact-channel normal form.

verdict_matrix.imported_context: Strip decompositions are established tools in other hereditary classes, including claw/long-claw related structure and theta/wheel-related lines.
verdict_matrix.R1_effect: Terminology and interface patterns should be checked when a FAIL cluster resembles strip structure.
verdict_matrix.limitation: No general theorem located in this pass stating that arbitrary P7-free graphs or C11 residuals admit such a strip decomposition.

source.title: Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs. II. Finding an Excellent Precoloring

verdict_matrix.exact_hypothesis: Lemma 11 assumes a seeded precoloring of a P6-free graph satisfying axioms (i)-(v).
verdict_matrix.R1_effect: Source authority cannot be imported as a P7 theorem.

verdict_matrix.candidate_being_falsified: Any shortcut claiming a polynomial algorithm for unrestricted 4-Precoloring Extension on all P7-free graphs without implying P=NP.

source.title: Updating the complexity status of coloring graphs without a fixed induced linear forest

verdict_matrix.imported_fact: 4-Precoloring Extension is NP-complete on P7-free graphs.
verdict_matrix.R1_effect: Any C11/seeded polynomial mechanism must exploit strictly narrower structure than arbitrary P7-free precoloring extension.

source.author: Shenwei Huang
source.title: Improved complexity results on k-coloring Pt-free graphs

verdict_matrix.R1_effect: R1 is not a generic P7 decomposition algorithm; a successful survey cannot be promoted to full polynomial coloring without R4-R6.

verdict_matrix.conclusion: No source in this pass was located that states the project's exact unique-hub/reachability-lattice/arbitrary-bipartite-X normal form as a known theorem.
verdict_matrix.novelty_rule: This is not a novelty claim.

verdict_matrix.conclusion: No explicit erratum/correction was located in this targeted pass.
verdict_matrix.caveat: Absence in search is not proof of absence.

verdict_matrix.conclusion: No clearly authoritative public reference implementation or benchmark corpus for these exact pipelines was located in this pass.
verdict_matrix.caveat: Not located is not evidence of nonexistence.

source_driven_R1_design_changes.action: For each authoritative residual, record maximal strong-module partition and quotient metadata as source-backed structural context.
If a residual itself is bipartite and P7-free, record/import its known chain-decomposition status before inventing a new decomposition descriptor.
When a minimal separator/PMC is used in a FAIL explanation, distinguish separator cardinality from known <=22/<=68 neighborhood-cover certificates.
Do not apply P7-free bipartite chain theorems to channel graph X unless X itself is independently proved P7-free.

per_residual_preprocessing: bipartite flag; if true, import chain-decomposition status
FAIL_certificate: or compact forced-R -> forced-L implication path
forbidden_promotions: bipartite X -> P7-free X without proof

next_governed_step: Freeze the authoritative C11 residual corpus and write an R1 preregistration that incorporates the source-driven metadata/firewalls above. Do not execute before preregistration is sealed.
